niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces with strong clarity and structure: clear visual hierarchy, explicit labels, grouped sections, and obvious primary actions. They often favor layouts with breathing room and reduced clutter, but this is conditional rather than absolute—they also respond positively to denser, information-rich designs when the content is well organized and visually high-tech. They frequently prefer dark navy or near-black themes with controlled contrast, subtle gradients, and polished depth, though in some contexts they also choose light backgrounds when they improve readability and hierarchy. They like rounded but not overly puffy corners, card-based organization, prominent imagery or focal hero elements when relevant, and restrained, consistent accent usage rather than scattered emphasis.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers screens with a strong focal point, clear headline-to-detail hierarchy, explicit sectioning, readable grouping, and obvious primary actions over flatter or more fragmented layouts.
Prefers content organized into distinct cards, panels, grouped rows, or clearly separated sections rather than loose overlays, monolithic blocks, or weakly separated content.
Generally prefers more whitespace, roomier spacing, and less cramped composition, with clearer separation between major elements and reduced visual crowding.
Often prefers dark navy or near-black interfaces with controlled contrast, dimmed backdrops, subtle gradients, and immersive presentation over washed-out or low-contrast alternatives.
Frequently prefers richer content, more visible details, feature lists, metrics, and explicit contextual information when it is presented in a structured and readable way.
Prefers softer rounded cards, inputs, buttons, and modal corners, but usually not excessively pill-like or overly puffy treatments.
Prefers consistent, selective accent usage and a polished aesthetic—muted or controlled highlights, subtle depth, and refined styling rather than scattered, overly bright, or noisy emphasis.
